title: Shine Text
description: A light that keeps passing over a headline: a gradient sweep clipped to the letters.
usage: One headline per page, large. The sweep is a background gradient moving behind clipped text — no script, and it survives copy-paste intact. On dark panels the same part runs light-on-dark (see the example).
a11y: The text is real text in a real heading; the gradient is paint. Under prefers-reduced-motion the sweep stops and the headline sits at full contrast — check yours does, because a mid-sweep frame must never be the resting state.
